result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations on a plane quartic written as sums of square roots of products of linear forms (x, y, z, ξ, η, ζ with parameters α, β, γ, α', β', γ'). The page assigns binary characteristics to these square roots and works out the parameter relations between different representations.
